description: In server.rs route_method Blob/copy, every blobId in the request is reported as successfully copied regardless of whether it is a valid CID or whether the block actually exists in IPFS. RFC 9404 §4.2 requires that non-existent blobs be reported in notCopied. The current implementation claims success for garbage strings and unknown CIDs, which misrepresents the state to the client.
title: Blob/copy does not validate that blobIds exist before reporting success
